note: DIRECT OWNER APPROVAL of the structured-scope binding for programme projectos-autonomous-self-hosting, phase PROJECTOS-AUTONOMOUS-GATEKEEPER-LOOP1A. WHAT CHANGED SINCE DECISION1C: nothing in the approved plan CONTENT. The approved Scope text is byte-identical to the text DECISION1C approved. What changed is that the Scope is now carried into the structured plan record and bound by the digest, instead of existing only in the authoritative source document. Two minimal corrections made that true: the plan projection in projectos/agent/src/planApproval.ts now reads the phase scope it had been dropping, and projectos/schemas/project-plan.schema.json accepts scope as an OPTIONAL string on a phase (not added to required, so no historical plan is invalidated). WHY IT MATTERS: under DECISION1C the amended runner.ts authority survived only as prose in a checksum-bound document, recorded as carry-forward PLAN-SCOPE-PROJECTION-GAP. It is now machine-readable in the plan the runtime governs from, and the approved digest binds it - proven by controlled mutation, where altering the scope text alone moved the digest from sha256:77a3add7ee to sha256:e2925757ca before restoration. THE APPROVED SCOPE INCLUDES, unchanged from DECISION1C: projectos/agent/src/loop/runner.ts solely to connect validated correction authority to the existing worker invocation, and projectos/agent/src/closureGate.ts solely so the programme-state drift check recognises the governed canonical current-state location. Neither path is writable by the autonomous correction worker, and that restriction is written into the approved scope text itself. UNCHANGED: all seventeen acceptance criteria byte-identically, the programme, the phase, the objective, autonomy level gated-execution, risk level high, required validator validate-all, required reviews code-review and security-review, owner gates commit, push, phase-closure, secrets-handling and payment-or-live-charge, every protected-action restriction, and the single local environment with productionFreeze true. The secret safety floor is unchanged: provider-credential-access and store-real-secret remain forbidden. This approval supersedes DECISION1C as the authority for activation; DECISION1C remains immutable historical evidence bound to sha256:6f5dc5ad25. Approval authorises local, non-production governance work only and does not authorise push, force push, tags, production, production database mutation, real sends, payments or refunds, credential changes, or phase or programme closure.
provenance: Transcribed by the implementer (Claude) from owner Murad's approval message of 2026-08-18, which named this exact digest, programme and phase, and which stated the approved Scope in its own words. The implementer made the two minimal code and schema corrections at the owner's direction, regenerated the digest through the existing plan machinery, and did not grant this authority. The owner ruled in advance that the digest may legitimately remain sha256:77a3add7ee if the structured plan content was unchanged by the schema correction; it was unchanged, and it did.
trustBasis: MANUAL_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL, tamperProof false. No signature is claimed. The record is a distinct reviewable artefact bound to one digest, and a forged approval is a visible diff at the owner's own commit gate.
